checks.name: initial state has no trades, completed tasks, evidence or measured profit
fixed point preserves 0.001 price and 0.01 fee without rounding price first
verified calendar excludes weekends, adjustment workdays and holidays
unknown future calendar does not pretend to know T+1 or observation days
ten day sequence is generated from calendar, not hardcoded weekend dates
observation needs actual day, source, time and fact/guess/check fields
future observation/quote and future plans are rejected
read explanations or mark task complete does not create preparation/observation/independence
same observation date rejects duplicates but audit correction counts once
one observation is insufficient to register buy order
unsupported platform permits explicit manual simulation, not invented support
10 CNY times 100 plus 5 fee cannot become executable under 1000 budget
submission freezes cash only, does not create position or measured profit
partial fill and cancellation retain shares and release only unused reservation
late backfill before cancellation is allowed and not treated as new order
T+1 has total 100 and sellable 0 on entry day, 100 next trading day
Friday entry not sellable on weekend, sellable Monday
1000 / 4x100 / fees5+5 / sell 3900 returns exact -2000 cents
1000 / 4x100 / fees5+5 / sell 4160 returns exact 600 cents
1000 / 4x100 / fees5+5 / sell 3880 returns exact -2200 cents
buy fees not deducted twice in equity or liquidation estimate
sell submission does not erase position; partial sale proportional cost and remaining shares
two pending sell orders cannot reserve same shares twice
unknown fill fees are explicitly estimated from snapshot; unknown model has unknown profit
confirmed zero fees are not replaced with 5 yuan
duplicate external fill references and overfills reject without mutating original
plan revision keeps original and reason, active plans cannot be silently rewritten
settings new version affects new plans only, existing fee snapshot stays unchanged
position forbids second buy and averaging down
closed trade prioritizes review, even if profitable; new buy waits
two completed rounds cap is an upper limit, not a mandatory metric
50 loss pause is sticky after recovery, permits exits and recording/review
manual pause blocks new buying but does not block existing sell/cancel/fill/review
holding day 5 is based on actual entry day, not route D7 or D10 deadline
correction retains original fill and makes prior review require rechecking
invalid correction cannot oversell or rewrite a buy date past a sell
full backup round trip and repeated restoration do not duplicate any fill or versions
invalid schema, units, IDs, or relationships reject import instead of dropping data
simulation profit or date passage cannot automatically switch to live
live requires explicit user choice after complete evidence and fees; defaults stay simulation
only one confirmed 1000 internal transfer, never add simulation platform account to real
hand manual simulation cannot be disguised as a live plan
AI handoff has units, modes, quote provenance, unknown values and no fake history
UI initial page has one current setup action and correct no-result label
all five views and secondary settings render without browser/broker APIs
UI quota failure preserves old event state; retry stores one event only
cross-tab stale state cannot overwrite newer training records
corrupt local practice data blocks writes without touching budgets
rendered imported text is escaped instead of injected HTML
practice shell caches all new runtime files; existing root/index scope logic remains
holiday after setup teaches one concept without pushing an invalid observation date
unknown calendar allows learning but never invents an observation day
today observed once means done for today, next lesson on next trading day
learning answer is preserved without creating observation days, trades, or independent proof
unfinished trade and review outrank holiday learning
guided lesson renders reference and recoverable GPT copy, and escapes stored answers
home shell retains all original budget controls behind an accessible details element
home starts from preparation and never writes fictional user progress
home budget shortcut opens existing workspace
home recovers damaged practice data without overwriting budget or practice
home completed day shows one day and preserves initial 1.1.0 event backup
home prior review priority is reflected directly in the primary link
first lesson is available without creating setup evidence
